text.en:
Barangays Bayanga del Norte, Bayanga del Sur, Bugusan del Norte, Bugusan del Sur, Kidama
and Sagad, all in the Municipality of Parang, Province of Maguindanao, are detached and separated therefrom
to form and constitute into a distinct and independent municipality which is created to be known as the
Municipality of Matanog without affecting in any manner the legal existence of the mother Municipality of

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 12th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
